162.Name: Save Maya!
162.Desc:
Oh no! The Frogzards are after Maya's book!

(Those Frogzards can probably smell that the Book of Lore was inked in blood and bound in human flesh and got hungry for a snack.)
162.EndText:
Thank you for saving this book! ! 

It is the Book of Lore.... 

Legend it is destined for the CHOSEN ONE. The Hero who will save or destroy this world! This is now yours...

Static.Name: Default Dagger
Static.Description: Dagger

170.Name: Trouble in the Bookstore?
170.Desc: What is all that noise coming from the book store!? Sounds like boxes of books being thrown and emptied. You better go inside and check it out.

172.Name: Continue Journey
172.Desc: I saw Twilly passing by earlier. You should go catch up to him!

173.Name: Talk to the DragonSlayer
173.Desc: I've seen a lot of my friends in the area lately - as a matter of fact one of them is just over by the cliff! You should go talk to him.
173.EndText: You are not thinking of getting on that arrow... are you?

174.Name: Defeat the Gorillaphant
174.Desc: Oh that mean Gorillaphant! Go get him!
174.EndText: You sure showed that Gorillaphant who's boss!

175.Name: Save the Princess!
175.Desc: You recklessly flew on an arrow to reach a massive red Dragon flying above... now SAVE THE PRINCESS!

177.Name: Save the DRAGON!?
177.Desc: Get that Ring away from Tara and I'll take you wherever you want to go.

178.Name: Get on the Arrow
178.Desc: You want me to shoot you onto the dragon? This is a terrible idea. Get on the arrow.

179.Name: Walk to the Bookstore
179.Desc: Where did I find such a special and rare book? The book store just up the path of course! You should go see it for yourself.

235.Name: Aria's Plasma Dragon Egg
235.Desc: You've got a talent for finding Dragon Eggs. It's almost like it comes second nature to you. Oh, gosh. What if you find another one by accident? Maybe the Draconians are already protecting a few? I need to get the shop ready in case we need to hatch a clutch of them.
235.EndText: Boy, am I glad that I prepared the shop ahead of time. Bring the egg over here! We'll be ready when it hatches.

Static.Name: Infinity Baby Plasma Dragon
Static.Description: A loyal elemental dragon who will faithfully follow a hero attuned to the same element. Lighting breath comes separately.

184.Name: Zorbak Quest 1 - Shaken Bones
184.Desc: I need parts to build a better, stronger Undead to se me free! Or just enough to build a skull key! Those work on any lock right?

Static.Name: Zardman Fortune Cookie
Static.Description: It is your lucky day! Zardman fortune cookie reads, "You will meet a tall, dark, mysterious stranger. But that is where your luck will run out." Of course we have no idea what it actually says. Zardmen do not have a written language. On second glance, this is just a half eaten cookie with dirt on it.

2.Name: Into the Dragon's Lair - OLD
2.Desc: You have entered the lands of Vasalkar the Dragon. What awaits you here?

4.Name: The Dragon's Lair - OLD
4.Desc: We are at the base of the Red Dragon's lair! The beast's minions are everywhere. Are you strong enough to defeat these two blue Draconians?
4.EndText: Well fought. You show some promise as a Dragonslayer.

5.Name: Fight Up the Steps - OLD
5.Desc: Dragonslayers sometimes use dragon scales in their armor. It helps protect us from the fiery breath of the dragons we fight. Bring me scales from the Wyverns in the area so I can keep us all well-protected.
5.EndText: Remember, we can always use more.

6.Name: Path to the Dragon - OLD
6.Desc: Battle your way to the Red Dragon! Take the high road and and leave a carpet of draconian guards in your wake.

7.Name: Dragonslayer- OLD
7.Desc: You are ready to face the Red Dragon! Vasalkar is a huge, old, and deadly Red Dragon that has destroyed many villages. He guards his treasure hoard ferociously! Defeat him so that we may carry word of vengeance back to the people who have suffered.
7.EndText: You truly have what it takes to be a Dragonslayer. I invite you to train with our order.

8.Name: Talk to Thrax Ironhide
8.Desc: Thrax Ironhide is inside the Fortress.  Now that you have defeated all of the Horcs and won your way in, he will speak to you!

9.Name: Defeat the Undead
9.Desc: If the Pactagonal Knights want us out of Noobshire, we'll need to be able to use our OWN land! These undead are attacking us from every direction.  Help us get rid of them and then we can talk about Noobshire.
9.EndText: We have grown fond of Noobshire.  Perhaps Captain Rolith will agree to share.

10.Name: One Little Piggie
10.Desc: One of the little pigs has broken out of the barn - and it's no longer a little piggie! Go knock some sense back into the Big Bad Boar.
10.EndText: Once you defeated him, he turned back to normal? That's great news!

11.Name: A Boar's Tail
11.Desc: Hmm, it looks like that didn't work.  He popped right back up! Maybe if you grab his tail he'll go back to normal size!

12.Name: Affect or Effect?
12.Desc: It's not just the pigs that have been affected! Go through the fields and find out just what else has happened! You'll probably have to fight your way through, but I'm sure you can do it!
12.EndText: What kind of creatures have taken over the farm?

13.Name: Scale the Monsters
13.Desc: All these monsters - except for that poor little piggie - seem to have one thing in common.  They all have scales! Go get me some so we can try to figure out why they are here.
13.EndText: All of these are different.. this doesn't help at all! What is drawing them to the farm?

14.Name: Winged Menace
14.Desc: These Wyverns are the most annoying of all the monsters that have taken over the farm.  There are just SO MANY of them. I bet if you take some of their wings, the rest of them will find somewhere else to go.
14.EndText: Yup, these are Wyvern wings, all right.  But it doesn't seem to have done any good.

Choose.Name: Ninja Sword
Choose.Description: A sword made of folded steel by the master Ninja... Thyton.

15.Name: Who Else is Here?
15.Desc: You saw someone else out in the fields? Go find out why they are here!
15.EndText: Why am I here? Well, let me tell you!

16.Name: Bev's Tale
16.Desc: I was minding my own business and one of these Wyverns flew into my shop and stole my favorite comb! Once you get it back for me, head on back to Robina.
16.EndText: A Wyvern stole her comb? That's too bad. Thanks for getting it back for her!

17.Name: Find the Chickens
17.Desc: There are 5 chickens that have escaped from the

18.Name: Chase the Chicken
18.Desc: Oh no! BokBok the chicken has run away. See if you can chase him down!

23.Name: Find my Hammer
23.Desc: Oh man... I was really tired, so I went and had a nap, right? And then I woke up and someone stole my hammer!  All they left me was this little spear. Ugh. Can you go get my hammer back?
23.EndText: Thank you SOO much! FRED SMASH!

24.Name: Pesky Lizards
24.Desc: Those crazy flying lizards have taken over the yard in front of the barn and are scaring all the chickens - and scared chickens don't lay eggs! Get rid of those pesky things for me!
24.EndText: I guess we will just have to learn to live with these creatures for a while.

Static.Name: Brutal Sword
Static.Description: Looks just like a certain dagger, but bigger!

51.Name: Become Stronger - OLD
51.Desc: If you want to try again - to prove that you can be even better the second time around, go to Twilly in Battleon and they will reset your quest progress!
51.EndText: Hiyas! You can start Galanoth's story all over again by just clicking a button!

52.Name: Solo Quest
52.Desc: Go Slay some Wyverns for me, kid.

55.Name: Dage Kill Test?
55.Desc: This text is seen at the start of the quest. Slay a Zard
55.EndText: End text! This text is seen at the end.

57.Name: Go Keel Tings
57.Desc: Kill one of each ting wit chur judy chop

58.Name: Talk to Despair
58.Desc: OMG! Is that Despair from Tik Tok? Would you tell her I said hello?
58.EndText: Artix says hi? Oh yes, I know. I heard you. He is literally standing 5 feet from me.

67.Name: Do Nothing
67.Desc: For this quest... I want you to do nothing. Just take this quest and then turn it back in.

68.Name: Slay 2 Testzards
68.Desc: In this quest you must slay two Testzards!
68.EndText: Congratulations. You have slain two TestZards. Here is your reward.

69.Name: Hunt Frogzards for Teef
69.Desc: You must slay Frogzards until you find me enough Frogzard teef to fill a bag. I would say 2 should do the trick.
69.EndText: Thank you for all of these Frogzard teefs! The dentist will be so happy. You would not believe how many patents want to look like vampires.

70.Name: Talk to Artix
70.Desc: Go back and tell Artix hi for me.
70.EndText: She said hi? Maybe I should say hi back...

71.Name: Multi-Hunt
71.Desc: Hunt things on multiple monsters...  you can turn this one in anywhere.
71.EndText: Good job getting all of the items from all of those monsters.

72.Name: Talk to Zhoom
72.Desc: Zhoom runs so fast! Can you catch up to him and talk to him?

85.Name: Call of Doody
85.Desc: It is up to us, friend! We must slay the Guanotaur, Colonicus, so that he can no longer terrorize and devour the Dragonslayers (and other sacrificial tributes) who are flushed down from above! It is our DUTY!
85.EndText: Now we just need to find a way back out of this squalid bog.

93.Name: Defend the Rats
93.Desc: The Horcs are attacking the rats we were planning to use for practice! So instead, I think we'll use THEM for practice. Your first task is to bring me a few pieces of cloth from as many Horc Trainees as you can slay… I think 8 should do for a start. Now go forth and show me your fighting potential!
93.EndText: Good work, but what in the world am I going to do with these?

Static.Name: Bitterblade Staff
Static.Description: Be one with the wind and sky.

94.Name: Save the Rats
94.Desc: The Horcs are still attacking the rats instead of their targets! Go battle the Horc Guards to get some cheese - we can use that to lure the rats away.
94.EndText: Good work. Now the baby rats will be sure to follow you!

95.Name: Get those Wyverns
95.Desc: Bzzz... Bzzz.. Bzzz... that's all I hear in my head, day and night! Those wyverns sound like mosquitos! Get rid of them so that I can get some sleep.

Random.Name: Ugly Stick
Random.Description: There's quite a few monsters that have already been beaten with this.

Random.Name: Dravir Shortsword
Random.Description: Hand-crafted steel blades made by the Dravir.

96.Name: DragonSlayer Gear NOTUSED
96.Desc: Now that you have recovered the armor pieces, they can be placed in a spot of honor.  Obtain some Dragon Scales from Vasalkar - they can be used to forge your own DragonSlayer Class. (Quest requirements and rewards may change in the future.)

97.Name: Rats in the Cradle
97.Desc: Now that you have the Horc Cheese, you'll be able to get close enough to the baby rats to save them! Go save at least 5 baby rats, and bring them back to me.
97.EndText: Good work.  I guess I'll use all that cloth to make little beds for these baby rats!

98.Name: Letter Interception
98.Desc: It doesn't matter how many Horcs we get rid of, more keep coming! They must be communicating with their main camp somehow. Figure out which of these Horc Trainees is actually a messenger and grab the letter, so that General Porkon doesn't know to send reinforcements!

99.Name: Get the Trainer
99.Desc: We need to drive these Horcs away from Noobshire. If we get rid of the Trainer, the remaining Horc Trainees will be confused and lacking direction. Go get rid of the Horc Trainer, and bring me his horns as proof of your conquest.
99.EndText: Hah!  I'm going to hang these over my fireplace!

100.Name: Get a Clue
100.Desc: It seems that with all of the commotion going on in Noobshire, the King of the Rats has gone missing! Check the Horc Guards for a clue to where he is!
100.EndText: Great work, now we can go find the Rat King!

101.Name: Missing King
101.Desc: Without their leader, the rats won't be able to restore order to their society! Locate the King Rat, so everything can get back to normal.

102.Name: Take Down
102.Desc: These Horcs appear to be VERY persistent. Dhakk IronHide is back with a new group of Horc Trainees. Defeat him, and bring me his pet rat as proof.
102.EndText: This should be a good message.  Join me on the /horcpath so we can get into the Horc Fortress.

103.Name: Clear the Horcs
103.Desc: There are a lot of Horc Warriors on the path to their fortress. We will need to defeat them in order to gain access!

105.Name: The Horc Clubber
105.Desc: Try talking to the Horc Clubber. Maybe  he'll tell us why the Horcs need training so badly.

106.Name: Destroy the Barricade
106.Desc: If you want to get into HorcTown to talk to the General, you'll need to destroy the barricade!
106.EndText: Now that the barricade is destroyed we can approach the fortress! I will meet you there!

107.Name: Get the Key
107.Desc: So the doors to the Horc's Fortress are locked? Well, don't just stand there, go get the key! I'll bet one of these Horc Clubbers have it!
107.EndText: Now you can get into the fortress!

128.Name: Test turn in diff map
128.Desc: I'm Lurkle in Bludrut1.  turn in to Lurkle in Bludrut2

156.Name: Freedom!
156.Desc: Oh no! Did you hear that! We'd better go find out what that was!

159.Name: Grim Skullsword of Vengeance!
159.Desc: Ooooh, you have a STAR SWORD? Pffft. You need a SKULL SWORD! Today just might be your lucky day. You will find everything you need on those pesky undead invading town. Heehhee hee hee.
159.EndText: Huh, I didn't think you'd be able to to it.  Oh, well... here you go!

Static.Name: Grim Skullsword of Vengeance
Static.Description: GRIMSKULL HOPES YOU LIKE HIS GIFT.

160.Name: Dual Wield Skullswords
160.Desc: Hey! You already got a Skullsword? Well it's Black Friday.... so how about a second one for half off? Then you can duel wield. Half off your enemy, if you get my drift. Just help other heroes battle the Undead bosses and bring me 40 of their skulls. You know, there's around 206 bones in the average human body. I'm going to need those..... too.
160.EndText: Huh, I didn't think you'd be able to to it.  Oh, well... here you go!

Static.Name: Grim Skullswords of Vengeance
Static.Description: GRIMSKULL HOPES YOU LIKE HIS GIFT.

161.Name: test !!!
161.Desc: Testing real item turnin / removal from inventory

Static.Name: Grim Skullswords of Vengeance
Static.Description: GRIMSKULL HOPES YOU LIKE HIS GIFT.

167.Name: Ectoamber
167.Desc: I sense a lot of ectoplasm sticking to the Rattlebones... it's as if they are being controlled by a ghost! Bring me 10 samples of Ectoplasm and I can make it into some Ectoamber for you.

168.Name: Screamwave
168.Desc: I bet I can create a soundwave that can damage and repel ghosts. Get me 5 Bottled Siren Wails and I'll make you a Screamwave.

169.Name: Spirit Ward Sigil
169.Desc: If you want to keep yourself safe from strong spirits, you can use a sigil. Bring me one of the Groglurk's Talons and I'll make you a Spirit Ward Sigil.
169.EndText: Here is your Spirit Ward SIgil.

182.Name: Artix Auto Accept Quest Test
182.Desc: This quest was given uaotmatically. Despite there not being a quest giver.
182.EndText: You completed the auto test thingy. Nice jorb!

183.Name: The Bear
183.Desc: Defeat the Brown Bear in the cave in the intro.

192.Name: Box-pocolypse
192.Desc: Up for a challenge? This is completely optional. But you're pretty capable. What if you could get all the stolen boxes back in one go? Come on, sport! You got this!
192.EndText:
I really appreciate the help. Now the Sneevils are going hold a grudge against both of us! Maybe I should go with you. Come talk to me.

NEW! Quibble's Pet Shop Unlocked.

213.Name: Choose DOOM PACK
213.Desc: Epic Hero of Destiny Set Choice

Static.Name: Epic Doom Pack Chest
Static.Description: Equip and CLICK THIS pet to open a shop containing all of the Epic Founder of Doom set items.

214.Name: Choose DESTINY PACK
214.Desc: Epic Hero of Doom Set Choice

Static.Name: Epic Destiny Pack Chest
Static.Description: Equip and CLICK THIS pet to open a shop containing all of the Epic Founder of Destiny set items.

215.Name: Choose CHAOS PACK
215.Desc: Epic Hero of Chaos Set Choice

Static.Name: Epic Chaos Pack Chest
Static.Description: Equip and CLICK THIS pet to open a shop containing all of the Epic Founder of Chaos set items.

Static.Name: Epic Destiny Dragon (Founder)
Static.Description: A loyal Baby Dragon of Destiny, this li'l guy will faithfully follow a founder of AQWorlds Infinity wherever adventure leads.

Static.Name: Epic Doom Dragon (Founder)
Static.Description: A loyal Baby Dragon of DOOM, this li'l guy will faithfully follow a founder of AQWorlds Infinity wherever adventure leads.

Static.Name: Epic Chaos Dragon (Founder)
Static.Description: A loyal Baby Dragon of Chaos, this li'l guy will faithfully follow a founder of AQWorlds Infinity wherever adventure leads.

234.Name: Aria's Dragon Egg Quest
234.Desc: Welcome to my shop, @name! We just started setting up so I don't have any new pets for you to adopt yet, but if you're interested in getting a scaly friend, then I have a request for you. The Dragonslayers have been busy, and that's left a lot of orphaned Dragonlings wandering aimlessly in the Lair. We need to protect them, and conserve their species! Track one of those Dragon Eggs from the Red Dragon, and we'll hatch it here.
234.EndText: The Dragonling hatched safely! Thank you for adopting them. I know they're going to be really happy being a part of your family.

Static.Name: Infinity Baby Red Dragon
Static.Description: A loyal fire breathing dragon who faithfully follows a hero to be as it's eternal companion.

19.Name: Water Draconians
19.Desc: Water Draconians are stationed outside of the Lair, as fire weakens them. They'll be your first obstacle. Demonstrate your skills by defeating them.
19.EndText: Well done, but that was the warm up. The Water Draconians were weakened by the heat. Them flocking to this lava flooded lair speaks to Vasalkar's influence.

20.Name: The Wyverns
20.Desc: Wyverns are small, but fast. They're attempting to lure you into the Lair. Go on, follow them, and show them that they made an arrogant mistake.
20.EndText: Wyverns are small fry, but they've alerted the rest of the lair to our presence. Good. Let them roll out the red carpet.

40.Name: Two Types of Venom
40.Desc: Once inside the volcano, prepare yourself to face the Venom and Purple Draconians. They're tougher than their Water-borne kin, and if you can't handle them, go home.
40.EndText: You're too nimble for them, that's impressive. I've been bitten a number of times, but toughing it out gave me a resistance to their venom.

41.Name: In the Dark
41.Desc: Search the dark cave inside the volcano and find the Dark Draconians. They're stronger in the shadows. Show me what you can do when your visibility's limited.
41.EndText: It's becoming obvious that you're a natural. Most new recruits assume that they need to be magically talented to fight these types of dragons, but it's all about ingenuity.

42.Name: Using the Scales
42.Desc: You have proved your worth. Before we continue on,  I need some scales, fangs, and claws to make a new set or armor. Defeat any of the Draconians that you find.
42.EndText: Dragons are apex predators. Their main threats are other dragons. The Order fashions armor and weapons from their remains to level the playing field.

43.Name: The Bronze Age
43.Desc: Take the upper path and hunt the Bronze Draconians with me. They're tougher than the others. Don't let the heat get to you, and keep the sweat out of your eyes. It won't be easy.
43.EndText: I've never seen anyone take to DragonSlaying so naturally. It isn't easy. You have good instincts when it comes to Dragons. I'll sharpen you into a deadlier weapon.

44.Name: The Golden Age
44.Desc: The Gold Draconians hold themselves above the rest. We'll drag them down, and clear the way to Vasalkar.
44.EndText: Dragons are born with a greed for blood and gold. These are prime examples. Don't let anyone, especially Dragonlords, tell you otherwise.

45.Name: Beings of Fire
45.Desc: Fire Draconians are Vasalkar's personal guards. They served him when he fought in Akriloth's army. Extinguish them. Don't let a single one escape.
45.EndText: The Draconians are nothing but smoke now. That leaves their leader, Vasalkar. We'll smother him, just like his minions.

46.Name: Vasalkar, the Red Dragon
46.Desc: Vasalkar looks down on us even after his guards were wiped out. Ready your weapon, and aim for his heart. Slay Vasalkar, and end his reign of fiery terror.
46.EndText: Vasalkar is dead. On behalf of the Order, and the innocents terrorized by that fiend, thank you.

47.Name: To the Hoard!
47.Desc: Vasalkar's Hoard consists not only of precious metals, but also the the armor pieces of his defeated enemies. Fight your way to the Hoard on the lower path of the main cave.
47.EndText: You've done it! The way to the Hoard is clear!

6942.Name: Redux's Armor Token
6942.EndText: Take This Armor Token to /EpicFounder to choose one of the three Epic Hero Sets!

6943.Name: Redux's Dragon Token
6943.Desc: Here, have one of these too!
6943.EndText: Use this token to choose one of the three Epic Dragon Pets!

171.Name: Defeat the Sneevils
171.Desc: Please help me! The Sneevils are raiding my bookstore to steal the boxes that the books came in. If I don't get this cleared up my boss will be SO mad!
171.EndText: Your Book of Lore will wake up when you reach the town of Battleon. Good luck! Twilly should be able to direct you.

119.Name: Return the Diary to Veddrian
119.Desc: The Diary will look old and dusty. Check the first page for the owner's name.
119.EndText: There are pages missing! Why can't I remember…

120.Name: Unlock the Keep
120.Desc: Now that you've found the key, we can get inside the Keep! Use the Bludrut Key to unlock the door to the Keep.
120.EndText: The smell of death and rot coming from inside…why is it so familiar?

121.Name: Talk to the Spirit
121.Desc: There's a spirit here. Not only can I sense it, but I can *see* it! Let's talk to it, and find out what it's doing here.
121.EndText: I'm pretty sure I remember the diary being on a mantle somewhere…

123.Name: Remembering...
123.Desc: There are several pages missing from my childhood diary. I get the eerie feeling something here is trying to keep me in the dark. Check these undead for all 8 missing pages.
123.EndText: Now that my diary is complete, I can work on freeing the Earth Spirit.

124.Name: Stone Cold Dead
124.Desc: The undead wandering the halls have been denied the bliss of eternal rest.  If you can kill 10 of these creatures and bring me their essence I will be able to use it to break the ties holding the Earth Spirit here.
124.EndText: So, we need a chunk of iron, hunk of jade, and a piece of schist.

125.Name: Find Cursed Chests
125.Desc: Remember those 3 chests you saw while you were running around? Find them, Open THEM this time. It doesn't matter how creepy they are. We need those artifacts.
125.EndText: Go find the Earth Spirit's Bones.  I will meet you there shortly.

127.Name: Heart of Stone
127.Desc: The Rock Elemental's bracelet contains the power we need to face the Groglurk. Crush them, and free this floor from its curse!
127.EndText: You soundly defeated the Rock Elemental. There's nothing stopping us from delving deeper into the Keep.

129.Name: Fire Endurance
129.Desc: This floor is filled with Fire Mages and other Skeletons who serve the bidding of a fiery Master.  If you can slay 15 of them and bring me their essences, I'll be able to help this Fire Spirit.
129.EndText: Head off to find those chests! Be careful, though, they're probably hot!

130.Name: Burning Chests
130.Desc: I need more than just Fire Essence to call the Fire Elemental.  Take this skeleton key and look in all the chests you can find.  Bring me back what you find.  Don't forget to find the Oven Mitts first (or at least second...)
130.EndText: Honestly, I want a pair of these mitts, too.

132.Name: Burning Heart
132.Desc: Defeat the Fire Elemental and bring me his bracelet.  I sense great power in it, just like the Rock Elemental's. They will be the key to Groglurk's defeat.
132.EndText: Their fire is snuffed! Beautiful work. Let's head deeper, and leave behind the smoke.

133.Name: Ice Endurance
133.Desc: I sense something on this floor boosting the monsters' strength. If you can slay 15 of them and bring me their essences, I'll unbind the Ice Spirit.
133.EndText: Efficient work! Let's give that dreary Ice Spirit the good news.

134.Name: Icy Chests
134.Desc: It should be routine to you by now. Find all of the chests, and return with the three artifacts. Then we'll be out of here in no time.
134.EndText: Now it's my turn to get to work.

135.Name: A Personal Effect
135.Desc: Veddris was trying to escape on her own this entire time.  The Sirens are attracted to gold -  I'm sure one of them grabbed it.
135.EndText: I… shouldn't have kept my hopes so high. Don't be sad.

136.Name: Find the Hidden Room
136.Desc: Now that we have Veddris' ring, I'm sure I'll be able to call her spirit! I just need to find the right place... Look around and see if you can find anything.

137.Name: Find the Ice Spirit's Bones
137.Desc: We have the artifacts from this floor, but I was unable to speak with Veddris directly. We must free the Ice Spirit. Find his bones and place the Ice Essence there.

138.Name: Liquid Soul
138.Desc: The Elemental may be made of Ice, but its soul is Liquid Water. Catch it in that empty bucket, I'll dump it down a drain. Don't forget to grab his bracelet!
138.EndText: You did it! Now we can continue further.

139.Name: Dark Endurance
139.Desc: Wicked Witches and Shadowy Imps dwell in this dark dungeon, along with some horrible undead. The elementals have become stronger with each of them you destroyed... I'll need 20 bits of Shadow Essence to break the Shadow Spirit free
139.EndText: Now that the Essence has been gathered - it's time to get those artifacts!

140.Name: Dark Artifacts
140.Desc: The Shadow Spirit has told us about the Artifacts on this floor. Go gather them for me - we are definitely going to need the power.
140.EndText: Essence? Check. Artifacts? Check.  Time to find his bones!

142.Name: Heart of Darkness
142.Desc: If you can bring me the Evil Elemental's dark bracelet, I can use its power to free my soul from its eternal imprisonment within this accursed Keep.
142.EndText: Oh how the shadows swirl! Breathtaking!

143.Name: Dispel the Shadows
143.Desc: Whatever is in here has Veddris, and IT wants out. You have to find IT's lair. Use the bracelets. They will dispel the shadows veiling Its location.
143.EndText: That must be where It's been living, half in this world and half in the next.

144.Name: Stop IT
144.Desc: Veddris…You must defeat IT if we have any hope of freeing her!
144.EndText: With IT out of the way, we can perform the ritual to call Veddris.

146.Name: A Sad Farewell
146.Desc: Now that IT is gone, my sister will be able to move on. Now that we have found her bones, the ritual can be done. Place all the items around with her bones, and I will use her Ring to call her spirit.
146.EndText: The forcefield is broken! Now, we will be able to confront the Mistress of the Keep.

148.Name: The Groglurk
148.Desc: The Groglurk's beauty rotted away to reveal her true despicable self long ago. She shrieks at her own reflection, shattering mirrors when she realizes the beauty she stole from her victims wasn't enough. We're here to take revenge for them!
148.EndText: The Groglurk lays defeated. No one will ever lose their loved ones to her Keep ever again.

149.Name: Enter the Keep
149.Desc: Now that the door is unlocked, it's time we head inside to settle my nightmares and find the Bludrut Blade.
149.EndText: Wow... this place looks so familiar...

150.Name: Talk to the Fire Spirit
150.Desc: There is another spirit here that appears to be tethered to this floor, just like the Earth Spirit was. Put up with the way it talks and hear its story.
150.EndText: He's... quite flowery with his language, isn't he.

151.Name: Descend to Level 3
151.Desc: The way to the next floor is through that bookcase! See what you can find.
151.EndText: Another Spirit? I hope this one has an inside voice.

152.Name: Talk to the Ice Spirit
152.Desc: There is another spirit here that seems a little cold. We should talk to him and get their story, then return to me.
152.EndText: I think I like the Fire Spirit better.

153.Name: Grate Expectations
153.Desc: Now that the Ice Elemental has been defeated, the way to the final floor is open to us.  We just have to find it and descend!

154.Name: Talk to the Shadow Spirit
154.Desc: Hopefully, this is the final spirit that will guide us to our goals. Just like before, let's hear their story.
154.EndText: This spirit is far from innocent, but we'll need to cooperate if we want to get to the bottom of the Keep.

157.Name: Find the Bludrut Key
157.Desc: If you can find the key and get us inside the Keep, I'll help you search for the Bludrut Blade. If your hunch is right, one of these skeletal monsters should have one.
157.EndText: Who knew the Groglurk liked its Undead minions enough to give them house keys.

158.Name: Descend to Level 2
158.Desc: Now that the Rock Elemental has been defeated, we can move onto the next floor! Find that entrance and we can head down!

163.Name: Find the Fire Spirit's Bones
163.Desc: Now that we have the artifacts from this floor, we can free the Fire Spirit. Find his bones and I will join you there.
163.EndText: The way to the Fire Elemental has been revealed!

164.Name: Find the Bones
164.Desc: Find the Earth Spirit's bones - once you do I will perform the ritual to free his spirit.
164.EndText: The way to the Elemental's plane has opened!

166.Name: Shadowed Freedom
166.Desc: I have everything I need for this ritual. Find the Shadow Spirit's Bones so that we can free his spirit.
166.EndText: Sorry we have to help a killer. At least he's a weak spirit. He can't anything worse than startling people to death.

281.Name: *Find DragonSlayer Armor
281.Desc: Many of the Order's DragonSlayers were ambushed by Vasalkar's minions. These beasts have gathered up what remains of their armor and placed it in their Hoard. We can't let the dragons keep them as trophies. Go and take them back!
281.EndText: Thank you. When a DragonSlayer falls in battle, it's rare for them to leave behind bones. These can be returned to their families in remembrance.

59.Name: Find DragonSlayer Armor
59.Desc: Many of the Order's DragonSlayers were ambushed by Vasalkar's minions. These beasts have gathered up what remains of their armor and placed it in their Hoard. We can't let the dragons keep them as trophies. Go and take them back!
59.EndText: Thank you. When a DragonSlayer falls in battle, it's rare for them to leave behind bones. These can be returned to their families in remembrance.

232.Name: Enchanted Tyrant's Blade
232.Desc: Thrax's blade can be further empowered, enchanted if you will, with magical runes. Horcs mark or even tattoo themselves with certain symbols that conduct mana. It causes a powerful reaction with their weapons. Collect runes compatible with the blade's steel, and we'll be able to strengthen its capabilities.
232.EndText: Many thanks for collecting these runes. They're glowing, which means they've taken to the blade quite well. Take it. Thrax's blade will serve a greater purpose in your hands. May it strike true, and never cut into a foe's back.

233.Name: Bloodthirsty Thr'Hall GreatAxe
233.Desc: Thr'hall's Greataxe resonates with righteous fury. If we can channel the Clan's rage into its steel, its strikes will become even more devastating. Duel as many Horcs Generals as you can, and their mighty spirits will empower this axe.
233.EndText: You fought well, Adventurer. Thr'hall's axe now carries the unbending will of the Horc Clan, reaching its full potential. They want this weapon to accompany you on your journey. May it serve you well, and bring countless victories.

283.Name: Manticore of Infinity
283.Desc: A manticore has escaped the Celestial Realm, ending up in your realm, let's call it the "Infinity Realm.", help me track it down. Collect enough celestial threads, and I'm sure you will be able to tame it.
283.EndText: Thank you for the help @name . I'm sure this manticore will be in great hands, under your care. I bid thee farewell; I hope I see you again.

Static.Name: Manticore of Infinity
Static.Description: The rarest beasts are those with pride in others, rather than themselves. The rare Golden Lion only appears to heroes with endless potential, and follows them to watch their development over time. How will you try to reach infinity today?

284.Name: Manticore of Light
284.Desc:
Pure beings of the Celestial realm, Light manticore, created by a divinity, are noble and loyal creatures. Earning their loyalty is another topic on its own.

Attempt to tame as many as you can; plus our standard Elemental essence fee, and one of them may forever be loyal to your cause.
284.EndText: Thank you for the help @name . I'm sure this manticore will be in great hands, under your care. I bid thee farewell; I hope I see you again.

Static.Name: Manticore of Light
Static.Description: Celestials rarely keep pets, but lions are popular among the few who do. Their logic is simple. The greatest beings, those created by the greatest deity, deserve the greatest companions.

285.Name: Manticore of Malice
285.Desc:
The rage within the malice manticore is part of its indomitable spirit. They cannot be caged; however, they could choose to follow you.

Tame enough of them, and one may choose you as its new master.
285.EndText: Thank you for the help @name . I'm sure this manticore will be in great hands, under your care. I bid thee farewell; I hope I see you again.

Static.Name: Manticore of Malice
Static.Description: The king of beasts cannot be caged. And even if they are, they will not go quietly. Slashing, biting, and snarling, they'll claw themselves up from the abyss, eager to stake their claim once more. If they can’t rule the jungle, they’ll see it destroyed around them.

286.Name: Manticore of Darkness
286.Desc:
The manticores of Darkness are native to the Underworld, how did they get mixed up with the celestial kind is unknown to me...

Regardless @name , help me tame a few and one may choose you as its master.
286.EndText: Thank you for the help @name . I'm sure this manticore will be in great hands, under your care. I bid thee farewell; I hope I see you again.

Static.Name: Manticore of Darkness
Static.Description: Blue lions only exist in the Underworld, and for a time, were perfect partners for members of the Legion. Nowadays, most of Dage’s Beastmasters prefer to use blue wolves instead. According to the Loremasters, the transition away from lions started after the fall of Atlas. Bad memories, perhaps?

287.Name: The First Pirates
287.Desc:
Avast! That Bone-Beard bilgerat be sendin’ his Undead Pirates to snatch me provisions. Can ye lend a helping hookhand ‘nd help prepare the Red Betty to sail the Lorian seas?
                                                                                                                                      
First we be needin’ a stash Silver Doubloons! Undead Pirates 'round port should be carryin’ some. Try yer luck, matey!
287.EndText: Ye've earned yer first upgrade to the Alpha Pirate, me hearty! Good riddance to them scurvy Undead Pirates, and welcome aboard me crew.

Static.Name: Silver Rapier of the Alpha Pirate (Infinity)
Static.Description: With this silver in your hand, swashbuckling by moonlight has never been more fulfilling. Alpha Werewolves and Alpha Vampires cower in fear at the very thought of your impressive form brandishing this blade.

Static.Name: Duel Silver Rapiers of Alpha Piracy (Infinity)
Static.Description: Twin, sleek, silver rapiers of the Infinity Alpha Pirate. they are well balanced, and smell of victory.  Alpha Werewolves and Alpha Vampires have no where to hide.

Static.Name: Silver Bluster of the Alpha Piracy  (Infinity)
Static.Description: Take aim in the light of the moon with this sleek, silver hand cannon. Alpha Werewolves and Alpha Vampires have no where to hide.

Static.Name: Dual Silver Blusters of Alpha Piracy (Infinity)
Static.Description: You know what is better than taking aim in the moon light with a single, sleek, silver hand cannon? Wielding TWO! Alpha Werewolves and Alpha Vampires now have 200% less places to hide.

288.Name: The Skills of a Pirate
288.Desc:
Aye, them pesky Undead pirates show no mercy for the seadogs like ye and me. They be DEAD set on stealin’ our treasures for Bone-Beard – and we plundered ‘em fair ‘n square in the first place! 

Help me crew reclaim what’s ours and get yer hands on that stolen booty. Savvy?
288.EndText: A shipshape sailor I ever did see! Ye’ve earned yer second upgrade to the Alpha Pirate, matey. Keep this up and soon enough ye’ll be me right hook man, har har har!

Static.Name: Silver Alpha PIrate Hat (Infinity)
Static.Description: An silver-trimmed upgrade to your Infinity Alpha Pirate hat. In addition to being werewolf and vampire resistant, this armor commands respect across the world of Lore.

Static.Name: Silver Alpha Pirate Hat with Locks (Infinity)
Static.Description: An silver-trimmed upgrade to your Infinity Alpha Pirate hat. In addition to being werewolf and vampire resistant, this armor commands respect across the world of Lore.

289.Name: Not For the Feint of Heart
289.Desc:
Ye’ll need more than guts ‘n a pretty face to sail the seas with me crew. The Red Betty be a fierce lady, ‘nd it be time ye got a taste o’ true pirate life on the high seas. 

We be needin’ plenty o’ provisions before settin’ sail, ‘nd of course more Silver Doubloons to trade fer when we drop anchor in the next port.
289.EndText: Arrrrr we ready? Aye, that we be! A full Alpha Pirate through and through. Couldn't be more proud to have ye in me crew. Now quit yer lollygaggin’, hoist the colors, ‘nd set sail fer adventure!

Static.Name: Silver Alpha Pirate Armor (Infinity)
Static.Description: An silver-trimmed upgrade to your Infinity Alpha Pirate armor. In addition to being werewolf and vampire resistant, this armor commands respect across the world of Lore.

291.Name: J6's Quest for Bounty Pirate
291.Desc:
Looking to become a Pirate Bounty Hunter @name? How about a chance to prove that you are up to the task?

Not every Pirate has a bounty on their head, but every pirate is a potential target. Got it? Lock your target, and start hunting, Bounty Hunter.
291.EndText: Welcome to the Bounty Hunter Guild "subject". You are now officially a Pirate Bounty Hunter.

301.Name: No Moglins Sky
301.Desc: There is an asteroid approaching our world. Want to hop on my space ship and investigate it with me? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! Mostly because it seems to be changing course to collide with out planet and destroy all life here. Board my ship and let's go!
301.EndText: Wow! This is a major scientific discovery. Also the gravity on this asteroid is identical to our home world of Lore. If you don't have a Space Helmet, begin holding your breath.

302.Name: Frogzards in Space?
302.Desc: We are the first to see this rare asteroid... wait. My sensors are detecting.... this can't be right. Frogzards? How did Frogzards make it up here? Who gave them space helmets? Look out, they are hostile!
302.EndText: Good job handling those Space Zards! Now to check back in with the ship.... uh oh. The signal's being jammed.

303.Name: Space Sneevils!?
303.Desc: Spacefaring Sneevils are jamming our coms! We will need to take them out if we are ever going to be able to get off this rock.
303.EndText: Good work, comms are restored. I am picking up new life forms!

304.Name: Armageddon
304.Desc: The Dwakels are normally a peaceful race. But these strange Star Dwakels are drilling into this Asteroid to steer it on a collision course with our home planet! All life on Lore now depends on you pulling a "Reverse Armageddon" by confiscating their drills.
304.EndText: You did it! Our planet is safe. However, sensors are detecting a large anomaly. I can't believeI am reading this.. There is a Dragonoid on this rock! It must be ancient. @name, this is a once in a lifetime opportunity. That Dragonoid has EVERYTHING you need to forge a Star Sword.

305.Name: The Dragonoid
305.Desc: This is our one and only shot to forge a Infinity Star Sword from this asteroid! You will need battle the Dragonoid until you acquire ALL of the pieces. Once you have all the Star Sword parts, bring them back here to me and I'll assemble it for you.
305.EndText: Congratulations @name! You are ready to forge the first ever Infinity Star Sword. This was a once in a lifetime opportunity. Quite an honor to witness you achieving this. Access my shop to merge your Star Sword Components into an Infinity Star Sword.

Static.Name: 1st Infinity Star Sword
Static.Description: Forged from the heart of a once-in-a-life time asteroid passing our world... this is the first ever Infinity Star Sword. Whomever wields this energy blade, for all of time (and space), will hold the oldest and most sacred power our world has ever known. Eternal proof that you were there at the very beginning.
Static.RequireText: Complete J6's Asteroid Quests to unlock this item.
